mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, and fluoroquinolones including ciprofloxacin may have modest serotonergic activity, creating risk for serotonin syndrome; additionally, both agents can lower seizure threshold and affect CNS function.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only if benefits outweigh risks with careful monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, muscle rigidity) and seizure activity.
